description: Single-check mutants of the gateway ingest RPC boundary: the data admission check in the mutating boundary, the session and generation rules of the seal and resume retries, the producer assertions and the release barrier. The copy assembles the sources of the ingest, journal, session and destination modules, the storage seam and the schema modules under one go.mod; run it with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod and a module proxy, because the server depends on gRPC and protobuf: run it with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod, GOPROXY set to the file URL of the module cache download directory and GOSUMDB=off, so the versions resolve from the local cache without the network.
